$comment: How the sample church communicates (docs/communications.md, decisions 90 to 96 and 131 to 133). Slice 2 loads the phone numbers, the branded email template, and the communication lists with their members. The senders, the approver, and the topics are read by the slices that write sends. Messages come from content/communications. Person Guids are Cast people.

phoneNumbers.$comment: Rock system phone numbers, in the reserved 555-0100 to 555-0199 range and never a Cast person's number (validation/check-standards.js checks both). 'assignedTo' is a Cast person, which makes the number that person's personal texting number in SMS Conversations. 'campusPastors' gives every campus a personal number for its campus pastor (configuration/staff.json names them), in the datasets listed, so each number follows its pastor (decision 198). Rock stores numbers in E.164 form.

numbers.name: Rock Solid Church
numbers.description: The church's main texting line. Mass texts and replies to them come here.

numbers.name: Rock Solid Students
numbers.description: The student ministry's texting line. The student pastor texts students and parents from it.

senders.$comment: Who sends what (decision 132). Mass emails come from the shared inbox in the church's name, and Daniel Peak, the Director of Communications, sends them in Rock. Pete Foster's few pastoral letters (Easter and year-end giving) come from him by name. The student pastor sends student texts from the student line. Daniel approves sends that need approval, and his own need none. A first-time guest's welcome email comes from their campus pastor (configuration/staff.json). 'welcome', the outreach pastor, sends it only from a package with no named campus pastors.

$topicsComment: Rock's 8 shipped communication topics (the Communication Topic defined type), unchanged. Mass sends name one by key.

template.$comment: The sample church's branded email template, beside Rock's shipped ones. The HTML is content/communications/email-template.html, and the logo is the approved Rock Solid Church logo, resized for email. It goes in Rock's General template category, like Rock's own.
template.name: Rock Solid Church
template.description: The church's branded email: the Rock Solid Church logo, a clean white body, and a footer with the church address and an unsubscribe link.

lists.$comment: Communication lists (Rock's Communication List group type). Public lists appear on Rock's email preference page under its Public category, so people can join and leave them. Private lists are managed by staff. 'campus' true makes one list per campus, named after it. 'members' names the rule that picks members (see Membership below). 'preference' is the member's communication preference on the list: email, or sms for students who can text. Members are never people who chose 'No mass emails' or 'Do not email'. A list whose members are 'group-sync' gets its members from its sync in group-syncs.json, not from a rule here. 'categoryGuid' puts a private list in one of the church's list categories from categories.json.

lists.name: {campus} Weekly
lists.description: News, events, and this Sunday's message, every Thursday.

lists.name: Men
lists.description: Breakfasts, retreats, and service days for men.

lists.name: Women
lists.description: Bible studies, nights out, and retreats for women.

lists.name: Parents of Kids
lists.description: What your kids are learning, VBS, and family events.

lists.name: Students
lists.description: Students in grades 7 to 12. The student pastor manages it.

lists.name: Volunteers
lists.description: Everyone on a serving team. It follows the team rosters.

lists.name: Prayer Team
lists.description: The people who pray through the church's prayer requests.

lists.name: Small Group Leaders
lists.description: Everyone who leads an active small group. It follows the groups.

lists.name: New Here
lists.description: Adults who came to worship for the first time in the last 6 months. Group sync keeps it current, and staff use it to follow up.

lists.name: We Miss You
lists.description: Adults who were regulars and have not been to worship in the last 90 days. Group sync keeps it current, and staff use it to reach out.

membership.$comment: Designed, not measured (decision 133). Adults count when they are alive, on an active record, and 18 or older. 'involved' adults attended, gave, or were in a small group in the last year. A newsletter holds its campus's adults with an active email who are involved, plus 'otherAdultsPercent' of the rest. Men and Women are opt-in lists, joined by each connection status's percent of adults with an active email. Parents of Kids holds adults with an active email in a family with a child from birth to grade 6, when the family came in the last year, plus 'otherParentsPercent' of other such parents. Students holds students in grades 7 to 12 whose family came in the last year and who have an email or a phone that can text. Volunteers, Prayer Team, and Small Group Leaders follow the serving teams, the prayer team, and the small group leaders, whatever their email, because staff manage them. Each member joined on 'joinedYearsAgo' or, for people who came later, soon after the household's first Sunday.

events.$comment: Church-wide dates the message library ties to that no other configuration file holds. Each is a weekday of a month, counted from the month's first such weekday. Easter, Christmas, the baptism Sundays, Student Camp, the Mission Trip, the Starting Point Class, and Commitment Sunday come from configuration/steps.json and configuration/campaign.json.

$emailClientsComment: The email clients people read on, as Mailgun reports them, with their shares. Rock stores each as an interaction device type, and Communication Detail charts opens by client. Each person reads mostly on one client.
$castUnsubscribesComment: Cast people whose stories include an unsubscribe, so tests can find a known case (decision 131). With a list, the person is on it and leaves it from the newest email sent to it at least daysAgo days before install day. With no list, the person is on no list and chooses No mass emails from the newest church-wide email at least daysAgo days before install day.
